question:
Which of the following options is the closest approximate value which will come in place of question mark (?) in the following equation?

499.37 + 1.95 × 4.79 - 2.87 ÷ 19.70 = ?
solution:
Given: 

499.37 + 1.95 × 4.79 - 2.87 ÷ 19.70

Concept used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9dc39efa9ed4f0e8f3a13804d9cd35a57480c17ba618ddcb102c34a0474acd66.png] 

Calculation:

499.37 + 1.95 × 4.79 - 2.87 ÷ 19.70

taking all approximate values as per convenience 

⇒ 500 + 2 × 4.8 - 3 ÷ 20

⇒ 500 + 2 × 4.8 - (0.15)

⇒ 500 + 2 × 4.8 - 0.15

⇒ 509.45

which is the closest to 510.

∴ The required answer is 510.
